title: Battery-aware MPC adaptive cruise control for EVs: code, pre-registered tests, results and derived data
description: Python and MATLAB code, pre-registered test rules and reports, result tables and derived 10 Hz lead-vehicle speed windows used in a study of battery-aware model-predictive ACC for battery-electric vehicles. Raw third-party data (OpenACC, BMW i3, Renault Zoe) are not included; see DATA_SOURCES.md. Code is MIT-licensed; our own result tables and derived files are CC BY 4.0 (see README).
